claims.claim: ADM announced September 21, 2026 that its Columbus, Nebraska bioethanol carbon-capture operations have more than 800,000 tons per year of carbon-removal capacity and that it plans to enter the voluntary carbon-removal market using credits from that facility.

ADM stated the credits are undergoing certification and issuance by Puro.earth, with initial issuance expected by year end subject to audit completion; successful certification would begin a 15-year crediting period.

risks.risk: The carbon-removal credits are not yet certified or issued; market demand, realized pricing, audit outcome and economic contribution remain unproven.

contradictions.contradiction: ADM describes a large operating carbon-capture capacity, but the monetization pathway remains conditional on third-party certification and audit completion.

unknowns.unknown: The release does not disclose expected carbon-credit price, revenue, margin, customer commitments or project-level return economics.
Scout does not translate announced removal capacity into Alpha numeric underwriting, risk or data-confidence values.
